_comment: DBA-registered critical queries for Oracle targets. Fixed SQL written and reviewed by a human, never generated by the LLM. Executed only as SELECT inside SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY with a call timeout. The GATHER_PLAN_STATISTICS hint is part of the registered text so E-Rows vs A-Rows can be read from V$SQL_PLAN_STATISTICS_ALL.

probes.name: Recent orders report by region
probes.name_es: Reporte de pedidos recientes por región
probes.sql: SELECT /*+ GATHER_PLAN_STATISTICS */ c.region, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS amount FROM aidba_shop.orders o JOIN aidba_shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN aidba_shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1 GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY amount DESC
probes.slo_note: Latency objective set by the DBA team for this report (configuration, not a measurement).
